welcome.title: Let's find your next customers.
welcome.body: A few questions — in your own words, not a form. What you say here shapes everything you'll see.
welcome.meta: Under a minute · you can add more later

shared.title: What's your name?
shared.subtitle: The one your customers will know you by.

shared.title: Where are you right now?
shared.subtitle: This decides where the app opens and what it shows you first.

options.label: I'm starting my own business
options.hint: We'll open in Discover — find something worth selling, and where to source it.

options.label: I already have a business
options.hint: We'll open in Growth — go straight to where your customers gather.

have.title: What do you sell?
have.subtitle: In your own words. The more specific, the better we can find your people.
have.placeholder: e.g. handmade stoneware mugs and bowls for coffee people

have.title: Who buys from you?
have.subtitle: Picture one real person. Skip it if you're still working that out.

new.title: What are you into?
new.subtitle: Anything you'd enjoy making or selling. Write it however you like — we'll tune Discover to it.
new.placeholder: e.g. candles, jewelry, anything I can make by hand

new.title: Make things, or sell things?
new.subtitle: It decides where we point you to source. Skip if you're not sure yet.

options.label: I want to make them
options.hint: Handmade by me — I'll buy materials.

have.title: Welcome, {name}.
have.body: {biz} is set up. Growth is already pointed at the communities where your customers spend their time.

new.title: Welcome, {name}.
new.body: Discover is tuned to what you're into. Find something worth selling, and the rest unlocks from there.

finish.note: Anything you skipped lives in the You tab — add it whenever you like.
